meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一份 DESIGN.md 文件，用于指导 Google Stitch 生成界面。文件包含色彩、字体、布局、动效等规则，并明确禁止常见 AI 设计套路。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为 Google Stitch 项目创建设计规范，或需要一份描述界面风格和规则的文档时触发。

say.text: 为我的 Stitch 项目生成一份 DESIGN.md 文件。
say.note: Claude 会输出一份完整的设计规范。

say.text: 帮我写一个高密度、非对称布局的设计系统。
say.note: Claude 会根据参数调整视觉风格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a DESIGN.md file for Google Stitch screen generation. It encodes color, typography, layout, motion rules, and explicitly bans common AI design clichés.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a design specification for a Google Stitch project, or need a document describing interface style and rules.

say_en.text: Generate a DESIGN.md file for my Stitch project.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a complete design specification.

say_en.text: Create a design system with high density and asymmetric layout.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts visual style based on parameters.
